$description: How to check that a built page matches the spec. Every page passes all of these before it goes live.

checks.check: No horizontal scroll at any width; content starts and ends on the page margin (grid.margin).
Each section matches its pattern on desktop, tablet and phone (Patterns, Pages).
Every text uses one of the 13 type roles; nothing outside illustrations is under 12px; body text 16px on every device.
Only the colour tokens are used; text meets the contrast listed in Color.
Space between elements comes only from the spacing tokens, per device.
Buttons, links, chips, cards, stepper, tabs, FAQ and icons match Components in every state (rest, hover, focus, pressed, disabled).

One primary per group; arrows are always ↗; phone buttons 40px with a 44px tap area. Content sections: buttons of one group share one width. Phone heroes: short buttons side by side when they fit, otherwise stacked (B4h); home hero buttons at equal widths, stacked at 359px and below.
Each animation in motion.json behaves as in its viewer on desktop and phone; pinned sections release after the last step; reduced motion is respected.
Every visible text matches Copy v4; no text added or removed on phones.
Every image from assets.json is present, sharp at 2x, and has alt text.
Title, description, canonical and structured data match handoff.json for every page; redirects and clean URLs work.
Keyboard reaches every control with a visible focus; screen readers read headings in order.
LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1 on a mid-range phone; no layout jump on load.
Checked in Safari on iPhone, Chrome on Android, and Chrome, Safari and Firefox on desktop.

A hamburger is in the header at every width up to 1023px on every page (40px on phones, 44px on tablets) and opens the full menu; no hamburger from 1024px. Check it again after any change to tablet-menu.css or the phone layer.
Every section except the hero enters with the scroll on desktop, tablet and phone, and none stays hidden after a full scroll to the end of the page.
scripts/sync-mobile.py --check and scripts/sync-footer.py --check pass, and nothing in mobile/ or wide/ was edited by hand.

process: The developers send each finished page as a preview link.
The design team checks it against this list and the live reference, with before/after screenshots.
Changes go into the design system (a new version) before they go into the code.
